summary: One confirmed defect. Both existing tests pass, but a targeted exhaustion check reproduces the regression. The Path return change matches the documented contract.

findings.evidence: The patch replaces the final-attempt raise with continue. When the publisher raises TransientError on all three calls, baseline.py propagates the error; app.py returns None. README.md explicitly requires propagation after exhaustion.
findings.consequence: Exhausted publishing failures are silently swallowed, preventing callers from observing failure and potentially making an unsuccessful publish appear successful.
